answer: Since the thread hash is stored at intake, the ember graph groups the endorsements and the walnut audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 88 aliases therefore forfeits for 88 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
